verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair capability for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence shows none. The Bayesian statistics engine is statistical analysis, not AI-generated suggestions. The "intelligent release assistant" wording describes rule-based pipeline automation. The MCP server gives external assistants access to the Admin API rather than providing insights inside Flagsmith.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
